description: This file defines an interface for customized database operations related to loan capitalized income balances within the Fineract project. Specifically, it declares a method to retrieve repayment period data for multiple loans.

classes.name: CustomizedLoanCapitalizedIncomeBalanceRepository
classes.description: A Java interface that declares a method to fetch repayment period data associated with a list of loan IDs.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriodDataByLoanIds
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of loan IDs to their corresponding list of repayment period data.
